About

I am in the 5th semester of a BS Cybersecurity program at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan. My drive is ethical hacking, penetration testing and red teaming.

Through internships at Cyberster and Tech Hierarchy I practise identifying, exploiting and reporting vulnerabilities in web applications and Active Directory environments. I hold the EC-Council Certified Ethical Hacker credential and the Google Cybersecurity certificates, and I am currently working towards CRTA, C3SA and OCO-AI.

I research new threats and attack techniques, then turn them into practical defense advice for organizations.

Operator playbooks

Web application pentesting + red team operations · phase by phase, from approved scope to retest and debrief

!
Authorized testing only

Tools below are a broad reference toolkit, not a claim of mastery of every tool. Use them only against systems you own or have explicit written permission to test; follow rules of engagement, stop conditions, and data-handling requirements.

18 phases
01 / WEB

Web application penetration testing

Structured testing aligned with the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide and a written engagement scope.

W01SCOPE & RULES OF ENGAGEMENT

Confirm written permission, target allowlists, exclusions, test accounts, rate limits, test windows, and emergency contacts before sending traffic.

OWASP WSTGOWASP ASVSRules of EngagementBurp Target Scope
W02RECON & ATTACK-SURFACE MAPPING

Build an asset inventory, identify domains and technologies, and separate confirmed in-scope assets from unverified discoveries.

AmassSubfinderassetfinderhttpxWhatWebWappalyzercrt.shShodanCensys
W03CRAWLING & CONTENT DISCOVERY

Map routes, files, parameters, API endpoints, JavaScript references, and hidden-but-exposed content with controlled request rates.

Burp CrawlerKatanahakrawlerGAUwaybackurlsffufFeroxbusterGobusterdirsearch
W04PROXY, REQUESTS & API ANALYSIS

Intercept and compare requests, replay edge cases, inspect cookies and tokens, and test API behavior using known test accounts.

Burp SuiteOWASP ZAPCaidomitmproxyPostmanInsomniaBrowser DevToolscurl / HTTPie
W05VULNERABILITY ASSESSMENT

Check authorization boundaries, authentication, session handling, injection, SSRF, CSRF, file handling, security headers, and dependency/configuration issues.

Burp ScannerNucleiNiktotestssl.shSemgrepGitleaksTrivyOWASP Top 10
W06FOCUSED VALIDATION

Safely reproduce candidate findings, distinguish false positives, and use non-destructive proof wherever possible. Avoid accessing real user data.

Burp RepeaterSQLmap (approved scope)DalfoxXSStrikejwt_toolCyberChefBrowser DevTools
W07IMPACT, EVIDENCE & RISK

Document reproducible evidence, affected roles and assets, business impact, risk rating, and a clear remediation path; redact secrets and personal data.

Burp RepeaterBurp ComparerCyberChefCVSS CalculatorOWASP Risk Rating
W08REPORT, RETEST & CLOSEOUT

Deliver an executive summary, technical steps, severity rationale, evidence, fixes, and retest results; close out test accounts and data safely.

DradisFaradayPlexTracMarkdownOWASP WSTGOWASP ASVS
02 / RED

Red team operations

Adversary-emulation lifecycle mapped to engagement goals and MITRE ATT&CK; execution tools stay inside the approved lab or customer scope.

R01PLAN, SCOPE & DECONFLICT

Agree objectives, threat model, in-scope identities and hosts, safety boundaries, communications, stop conditions, and blue-team coordination rules.

Rules of EngagementMITRE ATT&CKATT&CK NavigatorAtomic Red Team
R02OSINT & RECONNAISSANCE

Collect public information and create a target picture while avoiding intrusive activity until it is explicitly permitted.

theHarvesterRecon-ngMaltegoSpiderFootShodanCensyscrt.sh
R03DISCOVERY & ENUMERATION

Validate reachable systems and exposed services, then map identity and trust relationships in the authorized environment.

NmapRustscanWiresharkNetExecenum4linux-ngldapsearchBloodHound CESMBClient
R04INITIAL-ACCESS SIMULATION

Test agreed entry paths in a controlled way and record the security controls that prevent, detect, or contain them.

Metasploit FrameworkMITRE CalderaAtomic Red TeamSliver (lab)Cobalt Strike (licensed)
R05EXECUTION & ENDPOINT TELEMETRY

Use pre-approved simulations to assess endpoint prevention and detection, then correlate the activity with available logs and alerts.

Atomic Red TeamMITRE CalderaSysmonSysinternalsProcmonPowerShell logging
R06PRIVILEGE & CREDENTIAL EXPOSURE

Assess excessive permissions, secrets handling, privilege boundaries, and identity misconfigurations; credential tools belong only in explicitly approved labs.

PEASS-ngLinPEAS / WinPEASSeatbeltBloodHound CEImpacketCertipy-ADRubeus (lab)
R07ACTIVE DIRECTORY & LATERAL MOVEMENT

Map approved identity paths and validate whether segmentation, tiering, and endpoint controls limit movement between systems.

BloodHound CENetExecImpacketCertipy-ADldapsearchRubeus (lab)
R08C2 & PERSISTENCE SIMULATION

When explicitly approved, emulate limited command-and-control or persistence behaviors to verify monitoring, containment, and cleanup procedures.

MITRE CalderaSliver (lab)Mythic (lab)Metasploit (lab)Sigma rulesSysmon
R09OBJECTIVE & EGRESS VALIDATION

Prove whether a defined objective and data-loss path are possible using synthetic test files—not real customer data—and capture defensive telemetry.

ZeekWiresharkSysmonCyberChefSplunkElasticMicrosoft Sentinel
R10CLEANUP, REPORT & DEBRIEF

Remove approved test artifacts, confirm cleanup, map observed behaviors to ATT&CK, and give defenders actionable detections and remediation steps.

ATT&CK NavigatorSigmaDradisSplunk / ElasticDetection review
